sources.title: News Sharing on Social Media: Mapping the Ideology of News Media, Politicians, and the Mass Public
Partisan Bias Scores for Web Domains
sources.authors: Robertson, Jiang, Joseph, Friedland, Lazer & Wilson

meta.note: The score measures who SHARES a domain (audience partisanship, -1 left-leaning, +1 right-leaning), not a judgement of its content. A score near 0 does not mean a domain is neutral or reliable. About 180 major outlets use the newer Eady et al. data (politicians’ news sharing 2017-2020), mapped onto the Robertson scale with a linear fit; every other domain comes from the 2017-2018 Robertson et al. data, and some have changed since. Every scored domain is included, so a score near 0 means a balanced audience, not a neutral site.
